explanation: An evil king of Judah who reigned for 55 years and led the people away from God by worshiping idols and practicing wicked deeds.
Son of Manasseh and king of Judah after his father, also known for his wickedness and idolatry.
King of Judah who succeeded Amon and carried out a religious reform by removing idols and restoring the worship of God.
Father of Manasseh and king of Judah who was faithful to God and ensured that the people followed God's laws and commands.
A person chosen by God to convey God's message and instructions to the people.
False gods or statues that people worship instead of the true God.
Actions that go against God's will and laws, leading to separation between people and God.
God's just punishment or consequences for human sin and disobedience.
